children.name: Lead
children.text: SeaTrial Explorer turns a full-mission ship simulator into a pre-sales web tool. In one meeting, a sales engineer and a ship owner compare propulsion and rudder set-ups in the same standard harbour manoeuvre — and see what the difference means in time and operating cost, before the newbuild’s specification is frozen.
